title: Bumblebee reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="36" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#bfe8ff" transform="rotate(-30 36 36)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="36" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#bfe8ff" transform="rotate(30 64 36)"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1="44" y1="30" x2="38" y2="20" stroke="#7a5a00" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="37" cy="18" r="3" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="30" x2="62" y2="20" stroke="#7a5a00" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="18" r="3" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d="M32 48 Q50 42 68 48" stroke="#3a2a00" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M31 60 Q50 55 69 60" stroke="#3a2a00" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="13" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a00"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a00"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="34" r="1.3" fill="#bfe8ff"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="34" r="1.3" fill="#bfe8ff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M45 42 Q50 46 55 42" stroke="#7a5a00" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <line x1="30" y1="58" x2="24" y2="70" stroke="#7a5a00" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="58" x2="76" y2="70" stroke="#7a5a00" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x="20" y="66" width="28" height="22" rx="2" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <rect x="50" y="66" width="28" height="22" rx="2" fill="#ff8c8c"/>
  <line x1="49" y1="66" x2="49" y2="88" stroke="#cc4444" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="72" x2="43" y2="72" stroke="#ffd9d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="77" x2="43" y2="77" stroke="#ffd9d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="82" x2="43" y2="82" stroke="#ffd9d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="72" x2="73" y2="72" stroke="#ffd9d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="77" x2="73" y2="77" stroke="#ffd9d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="82" x2="73" y2="82" stroke="#ffd9d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <polygon points="50,75 47,82 53,82" fill="#7a5a00"/>
</svg>
